title: 2030 — First district hulls districts certified: swarm fleets assembly
definition: 2030 milestone on the Swarm Construction Districts roadmap.
description:
First district hulls districts certified: swarm fleets assembly at half the time and carbon of legacy builds.

What must be true first: the swarm fleets results have to replicate outside the lab, district logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and task allocation operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed swarm fleets demonstrations, district logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting task allocation uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Swarm Construction Districts
definition: Estimates Swarm Construction Districts readiness from component maturity.
description:

Honest scoring is the point: a district hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Swarm Construction Districts Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Swarm Construction Districts operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Swarm Construction Districts installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 4247 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where swarm fleets monitoring, district logistics redundancy, or task allocation maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Swarm Construction Districts Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Swarm Construction Districts: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Swarm Construction Districts — districts built entirely by swarms.

Phase 1 — Prove (swarm fleets): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (district logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (task allocation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (safety zones): district hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
